steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: Navigate to the Desk page, which displays research readiness data and pilot studies.
steps.point_out: The 'Desk' link in the top nav is highlighted, and you see section headers below for 'Microscope Readiness' and 'Scout Ledger'.

steps.title: Expand the Microscope Readiness section
steps.narration: Click the Microscope Readiness section to see the corpus totals and band-touch count. This data now loads faster on repeat views thanks to internal caching.
steps.point_out: The section expands to show 'Corpus Totals' table with figures like distinct symbol-days, datasets, and RTH minutes. Below that is the 'Joinable corpus — band touches' value.

steps.title: Collapse and re-expand to verify stability
steps.narration: Click the header again to collapse, then expand once more. The band-touch value remains identical—this confirms the caching change preserves correctness.
steps.point_out: The 'Joinable corpus — band touches' value is the same both times you open the section.

steps.title: Expand Scout Ledger
steps.narration: Scroll down and open the Scout Ledger section to view pilot-study families and their trial variants. The selector table has been consolidated internally.
steps.point_out: The section shows a 'Ledger chain verification: ok' line, followed by pilot-study family blocks with headers and trial-row tables.
